subject: Midget sub
topic: This tiny submarine was hit by the very first American shots of the Pacific war.
script:
This tiny submarine was hit by the very first American shots of the Pacific war.
It's a Japanese mini submarine, lying off the entrance to Pearl Harbor.
On the morning of December seventh, nineteen forty-one, the destroyer USS Ward spotted it.
Ward opened fire and sank it, ninety minutes before the air attack on Pearl Harbor began.
Those shots came before a single bomb fell on Pearl Harbor.
Subs like this carried a crew of just two people.
For decades, the wreck was lost. It was finally found in two thousand two.
On the seventy-fifth anniversary of the attack, NOAA's team came back to explore it.
Did you know about this part of the story?
pkg_title: The Sub That Was Sunk BEFORE Pearl Harbor 🇺🇸 #Shorts
